result.title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
result.summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 RetryRealistic 故障注入测试床，评估四个工具型 LLM agent 在 9 类工具故障下的恢复表现，发现「静默摄取」导致自信编造，并提出 verification-first Monitor 以校验工具输出、降低编造率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「静默摄取」与验证优先监督可供核查 LVR 中视觉或工具证据在进入推理状态前是否被校验，以及重试、停止决策与 CoT 审慎对证据筛选的作用；虽非视觉推理工作，方法线索较明确。
